cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a computer engineer and lecturer with a PhD focus on trustworthy AI and large language models. In my recent work I evaluated LLMs for Turkish summarization and built evaluation frameworks that balance performance with safety. I wrote Python scripts to integrate these models into web services and taught students how to deploy AI solutions in real environments.

At Toros University I led a department and co-founded a technology centre where I managed projects that connected academic research with industry partners. I regularly presented technical content to mixed audiences, from engineers to senior managers, and mentored participants in a Kaggle mentorship program.

My experience designing cloud-based pipelines for medical AI and my involvement in COST research networks have given me a solid understanding of enterprise requirements and data-privacy concerns. I enjoy translating complex concepts into clear, actionable plans and I am comfortable guiding stakeholders through discovery, evaluation and deployment stages.

I look forward to bringing my technical depth, teaching mindset and project leadership to help Anthropic customers adopt Claude safely and effectively.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş
